app_description: Practice memorizing new passwords and unlock patterns
mode_password_desc: Practice typing a new password from memory
mode_pattern_desc: Practice drawing an unlock pattern from memory
storage_visible_desc: The password is kept in memory. Full feedback and hints available.
storage_hashed_desc: Only a cryptographic signature is stored. More secure, fewer hints.
setup_confirm_pattern: Draw the pattern again to confirm
about_no_data_sent: No data ever leaves your browser
about_no_storage: Nothing is saved to disk. Refreshing the page erases everything.
about_csp_enforced: Content Security Policy blocks all network requests after the page loads.
about_pbkdf2_explanation: In hash mode, your password is processed with PBKDF2-SHA256 ({iterations} iterations). Even if the browser's memory is exposed, the original password cannot be recovered.
home_purpose_body: Practice passwords so we can actually use truly secure passwords.
